domain.name: IPPI-FT image morphology
domain.layout: single-channel finite float64 image with caller-provided one-pixel source halo, non-overlapping source/destination, and API-valid byte strides aligned to double elements
domain.operation: for every ROI output pixel, select the maximum of its 3x3 source neighborhood

target.build_target: AArch64 GCC 10.3.1 C++17 Release OpenMP ON, one runtime thread

correctness.definition: Each case calls the declared artifact once. Successful finite outputs and untouched destination padding are compared with exact numeric equality against a separate scalar 3x3 reference; documented argument errors require their exact status.

reference.accumulation: none; finite float64 values are selected without arithmetic

tolerance.rule: exact numeric equality for finite float64 values; signed-zero sign is not constrained; NaN and infinity are outside this evaluator's declared input domain

performance.definition: The same dynamically loaded harness measures the frozen source baseline and future candidates with identical image data, halo, ROI, strides, and call count; only calls are timed.

acceptance_policy.correctness: all 19 declared cases must PASS within the owner-approved finite float64 claim scope; NaN, Inf, overlap, and non-double-aligned strides are out of scope
acceptance_policy.performance: owner-approved weighted aggregate median speedup at least 1.03 and overall 95% confidence lower bound at least 1.00, with five positive finite raw samples per workload and role
acceptance_policy.regression: owner-approved critical workload 95% confidence lower bound at least 0.97

artifact_identity_policy.benchmark_binary: SHA-256 of evaluator-built harness recorded in every target sample
artifact_identity_policy.candidate_binary: explicit artifact path and SHA-256 plus dladdr-resolved symbol path are required
artifact_identity_policy.baseline_binary: pinned SHA-256 of original libftppi.so and dladdr-resolved symbol path are required
artifact_identity_policy.runtime_resolution: dlopen exact path, dlsym _Z21ippiDilate3x3_64f_C1RPKdiPdi8IppiSize, dladdr, realpath equality
